description:
[A delightful love story that begins with a brief but passionate contract dating proposal]

Ayoung, who was struggling after ending a four-year relationship, one day, due to a sudden realization, makes a special offer to Woogyeom, who is soon to leave for the US.

「First, a passionate love guarantees a light and clean relationship. Second, it aims for enjoyable emotions. These emotions naturally include both physical and mental aspects.」

Ayoung, who refuses to enter into deep relationships anymore, and Woogyeom, who has never had a deep relationship with anyone, start a relationship with a light heart, one with a predetermined end. It's a more honest and delightful contract relationship than ever before.
